summary: The owner-dispatched enrol run 43247933379 (a dry run; nothing executed) printed pss5's salted gid1- fingerprint. Execution refuses a profile without expected_game_identity, so it is added to the G2 registry, and the runbook notes that the canary is next. A salted fingerprint is not secret.

contract_status_changes.contract: Record pss5's game identity fingerprint for the G2 canary
contract_status_changes.before: G2 registry has no expected_game_identity; execute refuses pss5
contract_status_changes.after: pss5's fingerprint recorded; the canary can run
proof: make syntax-check, make test and git diff --check pass on current main
the registry loads with load_registry; fingerprint matches gid1-[0-9a-f]{32}

residual_risks: The canary is the first live action; the owner dispatches it.
